title: Atomic button whose text html-v3 envelope omits its required `content` field → Props_Parser throws → ATOMIC_SETTINGS_INVALID
_comment: WP-Q01 INVALID fixture (one-per-failure-mode, Detailed-Req #4; 12-error-taxonomy.md §3.1 ATOMIC_SETTINGS_INVALID). The `text` prop IS a correctly-keyed html-v3 envelope ([R8]) but its `value` OMITS the required `content` field (only {children:[]}), so the live Props_Parser rejects it and get_data_for_save() throws 'Settings validation failed.' (has-atomic-base.php:113) → classified as ATOMIC_SETTINGS_INVALID (NEVER string-matched, 12 §4). VERIFIED valid:false {ATOMIC_SETTINGS_INVALID} via Validator::dry_run on Elementor 4.1.1. prefilter.verdict:defer — the missing required sub-field is a deep/conditional validity the structural pre-filter cannot prove (html-v3 is not trivially-proven), so it DEFERS to the authoritative PHP dry_run (§4); defer on an invalid fixture is permitted by the meta-invariant. The tree is structurally a well-formed ElementNode (passes the authoring-schema check).
